static_traits.name: Lin Kexin
static_traits.family_status: Parents are from Japan，来访者独自在加拿大多伦多生活
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系因对金钱的Anxiety而紧张；虽有亲密朋友可倾诉，但难以谈及财务恐惧
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；此前without类似财务Anxiety问题；既往not yet接受心理咨询或治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、条理较好，能具体描述感受与情境；配合度高；情绪紧张但可Reflection与讨论目标

basic_info.main_problem: 因一次购买昂贵鞋子导致超支后，持续害怕“破产并not得not回到父母家同住”，在购物前后出现明显Anxiety与内疚，影响睡眠、饮食、工作与Interpersonal relationships。
basic_info.core_demands: 希望减轻对财务状况的恐惧与Anxiety，保持独立且not成为父母负担；通过设定“可承受的每周花费上限”、记录支出、制作购物清单等方式减少冲动消费并获得对支出的掌控感。

core_beliefs: 我without法信任自己妥善管理金钱，一旦出错就会失去独立。
如果我花钱not当，我会成为父母的负担。

special_situations.event: After buying that expensive pair of shoes, realizes the overspending
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one spending episode gets out of control, it may quickly lead to financial collapse and loss of independence
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Adopts a strict budget, carries only a small amount of cash, and limits shopping to avoid making mistakes again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会把钱花光，not得not搬回父母家。

special_situations.event: Before preparing to buy anything (such as a cup of coffee)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能每次都完美控制支出，就会滑向更糟糕的后果
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避购物场景、反复检查是否“真的需要”，Repression欲望
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If I buy now, it will become more and more out of control and I will fall into financial difficulty.

special_situations.event: Checking bills or balance and noticing recent spending
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 负面数字证明我财务管理很差，说明not yet来也会出问题
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Further cuts social spending; reduces non-essential consumption
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: See, I am terrible at managing money; this will cause big problems sooner or later.

special_situations.event: Even after following the budget for a while, reviews own spending
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 这些做得好也not算数，稍有放松就会失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: negate已有成效、继续加码限制与监控
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些not算什么，我做得还远远not够。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望保持经济与生活的独立，得到认可而not成为负担
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of losing independence, being forced to return to my parents and being seen as a burden
defense_goal: 通过严格自我控制与理性规划来降低not确定性与Anxiety，避免再次“失控”的消费

object_relations.self_representation: A person prone to mistakes who needs high self-restraint so as not to drag others down
object_relations.object_representation: Parents who may demand dependence or judge own improper spending

object_relations.self_representation: 因金钱Anxiety而Withdrawal的朋友中“难以开口的人”
object_relations.object_representation: 难以理解自己Anxiety、可能因此疏远的朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当咨询聚焦于金钱Anxiety的感受本身，或被邀请停下过度控制、尝试更灵活策略时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates relaxing control with 'losing control' and danger, believing only more plans and rules are safe
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 优先use客观、策略性与步骤化的语言，罗列计划与数据，尽量避免探讨脆弱情绪，语气平稳克制。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the overspending on that shoe purchase and its consequences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 下意识将责任过多归于自身，担心被评价为“not负责任”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责与道歉式措辞，弱化自身成就与合理需求，语气压低、强调“我not应该”。

manifestations: Strongly emphasizes maintaining economic independence and the right to self-determination; worries about being forced to return to her parents because of money problems
outcomes: 过度自我控制与回避消费

manifestations: 虽有亲密朋友，但难以分享财务恐惧；与朋友关系因Anxiety而紧张

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 将“not能成为父母负担、必须保持独立”视为绝对标准
Using strict budgets and restrictions as self-demands, hard to allow flexibility

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我检视与内疚感
对小额消费也高度警觉与自责
Overly cautious in expressing needs and communicating money topics with friends

positive_force: 有稳定工作与功能水平（Elementary school teacher）
Willing to seek help and cooperate with counseling, able to set and accept concrete goals
Willing to try strategies such as budgeting, recording expenses, and shopping lists
身体健康、without严重躯体疾病
Has some social support (has close friends)
negative_force: 灾难化、过度概括、心理过滤与预测not yet来等消极思维维持Anxiety
High fear and guilt about 'becoming a burden'
过度Self-monitoring与僵化的规则感降低弹性
对金钱话题的回避导致人际支持利用not足
睡眠与饮食受损、Decline in work concentration，反过来加重担忧

target_behavior.behavior: 与购物相关的高强度Anxiety与反复担忧（伴随回避与过度控制）
antecedent: Thinking about spending money before a purchase (e.g., buying coffee)
回忆那次买鞋的超支事件
target_behavior.core_reason: 一次超支事件被灾难化与过度概括，trigger对失去独立、成为父母负担的强烈恐惧与内疚
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定与内疚、寻求安全感与控制感
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and diet disturbance、工作受影响，Tense relationships with friends，生活品质下降
